old_problem: The common call exposed neither a bank selector nor resolved Advanced-RAS/no-plus1 values, and the x4 bank organization, bank-to-slot attribution, coverage, health oracle and restoration were unbound.
disposition_reason: The bank-granularity/no-plus1 purpose and PASSED/slot/no-light outcome are explicit. ED-03 permits adddcType, plus1-disabled, targets, duration and bank mapping to be approved runtime bindings; ED-09/16 keep DIMM service and injection operator-controlled. Execution remains refused unless the package proves bank mode and mapping, completing the review without borrowing Rank or plus1 evidence.
decision_basis: Directly read XLSX Reliability rows 25 and 27 plus same-row DeepSeek fields; row 26 was also inspected as a non-pending baseline.
Read historical record 2430 and preserved identity/hashes.
Keep Advanced Bank without plus1 independent from Rank and all plus1 variants.
Require vendor evidence that resolved adddcType and target mapping select bank-level sparing; the Items label is not execution proof.
Preserve adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False and the complete PASSED transcript.
No DIMM, BIOS, harasser, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Advanced-RAS bank ADDDC sparing without plus1
test_case.purpose: Exercise Advanced-RAS ADDDC at bank granularity with plus1 disabled on approved x4 topology and prove PASSED, bank/slot attribution, normal health and both indicators off.
required_package: Approved 64GB x4 DIMM PN/slot/bank organization and ESD procedure
Intel package build/hash and bank-mode/no-plus1 recipe contract
test_case.test_command: After qualified x4 installation and trained bank-map verification, an FAE runs `ras.DeviceSparingHarasser(...)` once per signed bank target using the exact Advanced-RAS bank/no-plus1 recipe while retaining `adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False`. Capture mode/target proof and the full PASSED transcript, correlated bank/slot records, health and both no-light states, then restore baseline.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved bank target completes the correct Advanced-RAS/no-plus1 path with `sparing_harasser PASSED`; correctable evidence maps to the intended bank and DIMM slot, health remains normal, lights remain off, applicable UEFI agrees and baseline is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires verified bank topology, vendor-proven bank-mode/no-plus1 recipe, full target coverage/PASSED evidence, correct bank/slot attribution, health, no-light proof and restoration. Rank/Standard/plus1 substitution, guessed values, generic CE, wrong target, UCE, lamp or instability is not PASS.
safety_gate: Powered-down ESD DIMM handling and qualified operator/FAE.
Verify trained bank topology and complete recipe before one target.
Stop on wrong bank/mode, self-check failure, UCE, lamp, crash or degraded health.
No automatic retry or next target before evidence/recovery.
expected_evidence: Row/variant/hash and x4 DIMM/bank installation map
Package hash and vendor proof of bank/no-plus1 parameterization
Complete target coverage and PASSED transcript
test_case.recovery: Preserve evidence and stop on anomaly. Qualified operators restore physical population and BIOS/ADDDC state and verify bank topology/memory health before any separately authorized rerun.

source_conflict.reason: Bank selection and harasser values are mandatory vendor-approved runtime bindings with distinct bank evidence; topology, oracle and restoration are explicit.
